subtitle: 길 묻기 · 문장별 음성 재생
desc: 길을 잃었을 때 길 묻고 거리 확인할 때

tips.en: Could you tell me how to get to ~?
turn left at the traffic light

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Excuse me. Could you tell me how to get to the subway station?

turns.speaker: Local
turns.en: Sure. Go straight two blocks and turn left at the traffic light.
turns.ko: 네. 두 블록 직진하시고 신호등에서 왼쪽으로 돌세요.

turns.speaker: Local
turns.en: No, it's about a five-minute walk.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: And is there a supermarket near the station?

turns.speaker: Local
turns.en: Yes. You'll see one right across from the entrance.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: That's perfect. Should I take the stairs or the elevator?

turns.speaker: Local
turns.en: There's an elevator on the right side.

turns.speaker: You
turns.en: Thank you so much. I really appreciate it.

turns.speaker: Local
turns.en: You're welcome. Have a good day!
